set(CANOPENLINUX_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/CANopenLinux)
set(CANOPENNODE_DIR ${CANOPENLINUX_DIR}/CANopenNode)
set(CANOPEN_CONFIG_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../config/canopen_node)

add_library(canopen_node STATIC
	${CANOPENNODE_DIR}/CANopen.c
	${CANOPENNODE_DIR}/301/CO_Emergency.c
	${CANOPENNODE_DIR}/301/CO_fifo.c
	${CANOPENNODE_DIR}/301/CO_HBconsumer.c
	${CANOPENNODE_DIR}/301/CO_NMT_Heartbeat.c
	${CANOPENNODE_DIR}/301/CO_Node_Guarding.c
	${CANOPENNODE_DIR}/301/CO_ODinterface.c
	${CANOPENNODE_DIR}/301/CO_PDO.c
	${CANOPENNODE_DIR}/301/CO_SDOclient.c
	${CANOPENNODE_DIR}/301/CO_SDOserver.c
	${CANOPENNODE_DIR}/301/CO_SYNC.c
	${CANOPENNODE_DIR}/301/CO_TIME.c
	${CANOPENNODE_DIR}/301/crc16-ccitt.c
	${CANOPENLINUX_DIR}/CO_driver.c
	${CANOPENLINUX_DIR}/CO_epoll_interface.c
	${CANOPENLINUX_DIR}/CO_error.c
	${CANOPEN_CONFIG_DIR}/OD.c)
target_include_directories(canopen_node PUBLIC
	${CANOPENLINUX_DIR}
	${CANOPENNODE_DIR}
	${CANOPEN_CONFIG_DIR})
target_compile_definitions(canopen_node PUBLIC
	_DEFAULT_SOURCE
	CO_SINGLE_THREAD=1
	CO_DRIVER_ERROR_REPORTING=0
	CO_CONFIG_NMT=CO_CONFIG_NMT_MASTER
	CO_CONFIG_HB_CONS=CO_CONFIG_HB_CONS_ENABLE\|CO_CONFIG_HB_CONS_QUERY_FUNCT
	CO_CONFIG_SDO_CLI=CO_CONFIG_SDO_CLI_ENABLE
	CO_CONFIG_PDO=CO_CONFIG_RPDO_ENABLE\|CO_CONFIG_TPDO_ENABLE
	CO_CONFIG_SYNC=0
	CO_CONFIG_TIME=0
	CO_CONFIG_LSS=0
	CO_CONFIG_LEDS=0
	CO_CONFIG_GFC=0
	CO_CONFIG_GTW=0
	CO_CONFIG_SRDO=0)
target_compile_options(canopen_node PRIVATE -Wno-unused-parameter)
